title: References, licenses and provenance
summary: References, licenses and provenance operational rules curated for Zanker. Independent synthesis; consult primary sources for exact normative requirements.

rules.title: Respect upstream licenses
rules.intent: Check each incorporated dependency and media license
principles: Check each incorporated dependency and media license
antiPatterns: Assuming public GitHub source is unrestricted

rules.title: Source attribution
rules.intent: Preserve required notices and mark original paraphrases
principles: Preserve required notices and mark original paraphrases
antiPatterns: Copying paid courses verbatim into JSON

rules.title: No secrets in sandbox
rules.intent: Block accidental .env and credential capture in preview flows
principles: Block accidental .env and credential capture in preview flows

rules.title: Visual Spec documentation only
rules.intent: Never treat Visual Spec as implementation source or codegen input
principles: Never treat Visual Spec as implementation source or codegen input
antiPatterns: Rebuilding JSX from Visual Spec artifact
acceptance: Only reference and document creation allowed

rules.title: Review before integration
rules.intent: Produce reviewable patch and avoid destructive modifications
principles: Produce reviewable patch and avoid destructive modifications
